## Limited information GOF tests

The `{lavaan.bingof}` package provides a set of LIGOF tests for CFA models with binary data.
Models estimated using the `{lavaan.pl}` package are directly compatible.

```{r setup, eval = FALSE}
library(lavaan.pl)
library(lavaan.bingof)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
(dat <- gen_data_bin(n = 1000, seed = 123))
mod <- "eta =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4 + y5"
fit <- cfa(mod, dat, std.lv = TRUE)
stopifnot(!is.null(fit@external$lavaan.pl))

# Test statistics
all_tests(fit)
```

As a comparison, we can look at the output from using the `cfa()` function in the `{lavaan}` package.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
fit1 <- lavaan.pl::cfa(mod, dat, std.lv = TRUE)
fit2 <- lavaan::cfa(mod, dat, std.lv = TRUE, estimator = "PML")

# Test equality of coefficients and standard errors
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(coef(fit1), coef(fit2), tolerance = 1e-5)))  
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(fit1@Fit@se, fit2@Fit@se, tolerance = 1e-5)))

# Test equality of test statistics and p-values
tests <- c(
  "Wald_test",
  "Wald_vcovf_test",
  "Wald_diag_test",
  "Pearson_test",
  "RSS_test",
  "Multn_test"
)
lapply(setNames(tests, tests), function(x) {
  out1 <- do.call(x, list(fit1))
  out2 <- do.call(x, list(fit2))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(out1, out2, tolerance = 5e-3)))
})
```

## Testing differences


```{r, eval = FALSE}
information_matrix <- function(fit, type) {
  lavargs <- list(
    lavmodel = fit@Model,
    lavsamplestats = fit@SampleStats,
    lavdata = fit@Data,
    lavoptions = fit@Options,
    lavcache = fit@Cache,
    inverted = FALSE
  )

  if (type == "observed") 
    out <- do.call("lav_model_info_observed", lavargs, 
                   envir = asNamespace("lavaan"))
  else if (type == "expected")
    out <- do.call("lav_model_info_expected", lavargs, 
                   envir = asNamespace("lavaan"))
  else if (type == "first.order")
    out <- do.call("lav_model_info_firstorder", lavargs, 
                   envir = asNamespace("lavaan"))
  else stop("Invalid type")
  return(out)
}
```


### Sensitivity (inverted) matrix


```{r, eval = FALSE}
# From lavaan.pl
Hinv1 <- attr(fit1@vcov$vcov, "E.inv")
fit1 <- cfa(mod, dat, std.lv = TRUE, estimator.args = list(computevar_numderiv = TRUE), verbose = TRUE)
Hinv2 <- attr(fit1@vcov$vcov, "E.inv")
Hinv3 <- solve(information_matrix(fit1, "observed"))

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(Hinv1, Hinv2, tolerance = 1e-5)))  # analytic vs numderiv
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(Hinv1, Hinv3, tolerance = 1e-5)))  # analytic vs lavaan
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(Hinv2, Hinv3, tolerance = 1e-5)))  # numderiv vs lavaan
```

### Variability matrix

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# From lavaan.pl
Einv <- attr(fit1@vcov$vcov, "E.inv")
J1 <- solve(Einv) %*% fit1@vcov$vcov %*% solve(Einv) * nobs(fit1)
J2 <- information_matrix(fit1, "first.order")

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(J1, J2, tolerance = 1e-5)))  # lavaan.pl vs lavaan
```
